belief: I’m not good enough to go to heaven.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that you are not good enough to go to heaven, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Believing heaven is a reward for good people. Deep awareness of your own sins and failures. Teaching that stressed fear of judgment more than grace. Low self-worth that makes you feel undeserving of anything good. Comparing yourself with people who seem holier.
teaches: You are right that you are not good enough to go to heaven. No one is. All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God. But that is exactly why Jesus came. Those who trust Christ are justified freely by His grace. The Father has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints. Jesus Himself is preparing a place for you and will welcome you into His presence. Heaven is not earned by being good enough; it is received as a gift.
self_statements: Heaven is for good people, not people like me.
I’ve done too much wrong to go to heaven.
God might let others in, but not me.
I have to become a better person first.
errors: Believing heaven is earned by being good enough.
Calling yourself “not good enough” as if that disqualifies you from grace.
Overlooking that God Himself qualifies those who trust Christ.
questions: Is anyone good enough to go to heaven on their own?
How does Romans 3:24 say people are justified?
Who qualifies me to share in the inheritance of the saints?
What is Jesus doing for me right now, according to John 14?
Am I trusting my goodness or Christ’s?
If heaven is a gift, can I be too unworthy to receive it?
truth: I am not good enough to go to heaven on my own, and no one is. But Jesus is good enough, and through faith in Him I am justified freely by God’s grace. The Father has qualified me, and Jesus is preparing a place for me. Heaven is a gift I receive, not a reward I earn.
hw_questions: Is anyone good enough on their own?
How are people justified, according to Romans 3:24?
Who qualifies me for the inheritance?
What is Jesus preparing for me?
Am I trusting my goodness or Christ’s?
hw_truths: No one is good enough on their own, but Jesus is.
I am justified freely by God’s grace.
The Father has qualified me for the inheritance of the saints.
Jesus is preparing a place for me.
Heaven is a gift, not a reward.
My inheritance is reserved in heaven for me.
log: Each day, write one thing Jesus did to bring me to heaven.
name_example: Giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified Sarah to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.
actions: and underline every phrase that says how we are made right with God.
trusting Jesus, not your goodness, for heaven.

and thank Jesus for the place He is preparing.

tracker: One thing Jesus did for me
prayer: Lord Jesus, I am not good enough on my own, but You are. Help me reject the lie that I can’t go to heaven because I’m not good enough. I trust You, not my goodness. Thank You for justifying me freely by grace and for preparing a place for me. In Your name, Amen.
